tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm cream in light; Heritage Navy in dark (night bands, footer, dark mode).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, pricing tiers, form fields and the secondary button fill. Navy raised in dark.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Alternating section bands and soft highlight panels.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text: Heritage Navy on light grounds (17:1 on surface), warm cream on dark (16:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, captions and meta text (6.6:1 light, 9.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and quiet card outlines only.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Sunrise Orange, the action colour. ONE primary action per screen, the active stage, the Customers outcome. Navy text on it (5.8:1).

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Orange as text: eyebrows, inline highlights (4.9:1 light).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Savanna Gold: badges, celebrations, the Capital outcome. Lighter and yellower than orange so the two never blur.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on gold fills (12.7:1).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Corridor Teal: progress, completion, the Investors outcome. Teal Glow in dark.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on teal fills (4.9:1 light, 8.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: teal-text
tokens.usage: Links and success text (4.6:1 light, 8.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Heritage Navy bands: RENZOLO OS showcase, Why RENZOLO, header and footer. Render with data-theme=dark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 3px focus ring, 2px offset.

tokens.name: tick-up
tokens.usage: Live score rising: the change figure and arrow on surface and surface-raised (5.2:1 light, 7.4:1 dark). Always paired with a plus sign and an up arrow.

tokens.name: tick-down
tokens.usage: Live score falling: the change figure and arrow on surface and surface-raised (5.1:1 light, 5.7:1 dark). Always paired with a minus sign and a down arrow.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Futuristic layer: translucent panel fill, with backdrop-filter blur(16px). Falls back to surface-raised where blur is unsupported.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Futuristic layer: 1px edge on glass panels and the faint dot grid on dark bands. Decorative only.

tokens.name: heritage
tokens.usage: Heritage Gold, from the original brand. Premium details on navy only: the ™, eyebrows, thin rules, outline badges (6.0:1 on night). Never as text on cream.

tokens.name: night-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on Heritage Navy bands.
